title: The Best Free SMS Gateway: Convert Your Old Android (GitHub)
description:
Stop paying for expensive third-party SMS APIs! In this video, I show you how to use a completely free open-source GitHub project called HTTP SMS by Endul Studio to turn any old Android phone into a professional SMS gateway for your software.

This setup allows you to create a REST API from your mobile phone, so you can trigger SMS notifications directly from your website or app. If you don't know how to code, don't worry—you can simply use Claude or your favorite AI tool to help you set it up using the repository link.

Key features:
- Completely free and open source
- Simple REST API integration
- No more monthly API fees
- Easy to set up on old Android devices

If you found this helpful, make sure to follow for more free developer tools and AI automation tips!
